headline: Father who allegedly raped 14-year-old daughter had warrant out for arrest before birth of ‘Baby Angelita.’
summary: In August 2024, Sergio Galvez Perez was pulled over by a Monterey County Sheriff's deputy, two years before he would be charged with raping his daughter and the baby she gave birth to would be found dead.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
